name: Dunkey Munkey
summary:
Dunkey Munkey is a retro-style arcade platformer where players navigate a series of platforms and ladders while avoiding enemies and obstacles. With colorful 8-bit graphics and classic arcade gameplay, the game challenges players to climb through increasingly tricky environments, time their movements, and achieve high scores.

Inspired by the golden age of arcade gaming, Dunkey Munkey offers a simple yet challenging experience that rewards quick reflexes, careful movement, and strategic planning.
